title: Multiattack
html:
This is a disambiguation page, which links to ambiguously named articles. If you were brought here by a link in an article, consider editing it to direct towards the intended page instead.
For the Hunter Ranger passive feature, see Multiattack Defence

Multiattack is a type of action that allows a creature to attack more than once when using their Attack action. Some creatures have a type of Multiattack passive feature that stipulates conditions that need to be fulfilled in order to be able to make a multiattack.

For example, Hook Horrors may only Multiattack  Prone targets.

  • See #List of Multiattack passive features below for a list of passive features.
  • See #List of Multiattack actions below for multiattack variants available to different creatures.
